name: Vampire
description: An intelligent undead with blood-stained lips and a predator’s smile.

abilities.name: Draining Bite
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 5d4 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.

abilities.name: Mistform
abilities.description: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can spend a Fear to take half damage.
